title: Web allocation / deallocation report (MCXCCL)
purpose: Collateral the clearing member allocated to the trading member and each end client (start of day, allocated and deallocated during the day, end of day), own collateral, eligible collateral and margin utilised.
linked: Loaded as each client's commodity collateral allocation with MCXCCL (Clearing allocation and Clearing data)

columns.name: OWN Collateral added during the day
OWN Collateral reduced during the day
OWN Others Collateral added during Day
OWN Others Collateral reduced during Day

source: MCXCCL File Formats (Version 1, Public), section 1.42 Web Allocation/Deallocation Report to Members (the circulars spell the file name Deallcoation); MCX circular MCX/TECH/394/2023 (19 Jun 2023), MCX File Formats Version 1.2, section 1.75
